info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections Method PATCH API
NGINX Modify a Server in an HTTP Upstream Server Group

params.name: httpUpstreamName
params.description: The name of the upstream server group.

items.docs: Modifies settings of a particular server in an HTTP upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.

info.name: NGINX Modify a Key-Value or Delete a Key

params.name: httpKeyvalZoneName
params.description: The name of an HTTP keyval shared memory zone.

items.docs: Changes the value of the selected key in the key-value pair, deletes a key by setting the key value to null, changes expiration time of a key-value pair. If synchronization of keyval zones in a cluster is enabled, deletes a key only on a target cluster node.
